Unfortunately for him, he was approached by a tiny lizard-thing that claimed to be a red dragon hatchling that had come to recruit him to become a hero. He refuses at first and, in return, the "hatchling" transported him into the game he was playing. He is approached by a beauty that claims to be the "hatchling". She proceeds to convince him that hero's are good-for-nothing bastards and tell him that he could never become one. He is returned to reality where he becomes determined to become a hero. But this entire situation was orchestrated by the demon lord. What could she be planning?

As Jiyong pursues the rental scam gang that evades proper legal judgment, he feels his vigilante rules being tested. And in the meantime, the four vigilantes involved receive threats from someone aware of their identities. They begin to sense the shadow of a great evil behind their adversaries.

At night, Princess Millaria, who dreams of an unnamed queen, becomes intertwined with the body of a queen from a hundred years ago, as if by fate. And thus, she discovers the queen's diary.

"I entrust the kingdom to you. I humbly plead with you, bowing my head like this."

A dark cloud loomed before her, causing confusion!

"Who are you?"

Ferdinand, the Duke, somehow recognizes her true identity. But crisis soon becomes an opportunity!

"Cooperate with me. If you do, I will turn a blind eye to your identity."
"Alright. But there's one condition."
"What is it?"
"It's not enough for you to just turn a blind eye to my identity. I want to be treated as a flawless queen."

Millaria, who has chosen to live under the name of the queen, and Ferdinand, the Duke who knows her secret, play a duet solely for the well-being of Queen Gloria, who only desired the kingdom's peace—a requiem for the queen.

Following an uprising, the nine-year-old princess of Grandia, Gris Benedict, had gone missing. In fact, she ended up working as a maid in a brothel, really no better than a slave. She spent eleven years in that hellhole but was fortunate enough to escape her prison. Her "uncle" promised to help her escape the brothel if only she pretends to be the missing young lady, and Gris accepted living a lie in order to survive. One day, she is gifted a small, cute animal by her fake brother, the Lord of Byrenhag. She figured it would be her first and last present from him, but then he kept bringing her bigger and bigger gifts... If ever the time came that he try to gift himself, Gris foresaw that their relationship would surely end in a catastrophe.

description.en:
A one-time dream connecting reagent was made with the intention to meet Daniel, the prince that she has an unrequited love for, even in a dream. However, it was her rival, Kaiden that took the reagent, and it wasn't a one-time thing?

Lizen, who has perfect grades and physical skills, is bright and strong on the outside, but hides her wounds on the inside. Kaiden, a man who is blunt and cold, but more warm-hearted than anyone else. Lizen is connected to Kaiden through dreams every day, and not only gets caught in a huge conspiracy surrounding the throne, but also gets confused with her emotions....

An oddly continous meetings in their dreams. Is it because it's just a dream, so it's easy to pass off as a joke, or has it become sincere feelings because of the dream.

"There's no point in 'if.' I already have feelings for you. I like you now even if I don't dream about you."

Reagen penghubung mimpi satu kali dibuat dengan maksud untuk bertemu Daniel, pangeran yang diam-diam dia cintai, bahkan dalam mimpi. Namun saingannya, Kaiden yang mengambil ternyata meminum Reagen itu, dan itu bukan hanya sekali? Lizen, yang memiliki nilai sempurna, keterampilan fisik, cerdas dan kuat di luar, tetapi menyembunyikan lukanya di dalam. Kaiden, seorang pria yang blak-blakan dan dingin, tetapi lebih berhati hangat daripada siapa pun. Lizen terhubung dengan Kaiden melalui mimpi setiap hari, dan tidak hanya terjebak dalam konspirasi besar seputar tahta, tetapi juga bingung dengan emosinya.... Pertemuan yang anehnya terus menerus dalam mimpi mereka. Apakah karena itu hanya mimpi, sehingga mudah menganggapnya hanya sebagai lelucon, atau telah menjadi perasaan yang tulus karena mimpi. 그러나 시약을 먹은 것은 엉뚱하게도 라이벌 카이든인 데다, 일회성도 아니었다?

무뚝뚝하고 냉정하지만 속은 누구보다 다정한 남자 카이든.
리젠은 카이든과 매일 꿈으로 연결되며 왕위를 둘러싼 거대한 음모에 휘말리는 것은 물론, 감정까지 혼란스러워지는데…….

description.en:
“I have found someone I love. So please break off our engagement, young lady.“

"Huh? Your real name is…”

One day I was obsessed with a poor novel *River of Forgetting* and lived quietly as a duke’s daughter. I discovered that my fiancé was an ordinary person who was a main character.

According to the original work, his love interest is a female protagonist and a saint, and I was engaged to a male lead… A supporting character is destined to be assassinated without the knowledge of any mouse or bird, right?

That night, I learned two shocking truths and confessed them to a man who was drunkenly passing by.

I thought he looked like my favorite dark character in this novel, the crown prince of Hyperion, Saul Lucius…

“Do you want to get engaged? Marriage or dating? An affair is fine…”
“Whatever.”

This man was Hyperion.

As a result, the engagement with the crown prince went smoothly…

But my ex-fiancé who dumped me has become obsessed with me. Does anyone know why he’s like this…?

Or rather, I’m engaged to a crown prince? Is that too much for a supporting role? Well, it seems like the real lead of this novel is different!

description.en:
To uphold her father's wishes, Seizel Aramis lived an honest and virtuous life, only to be betrayed by those she trusted, conned by crooks, sent to jail, and executed. But the moment she dies, Seizel wakes up in the past, right before her misfortunes began. This time, Seizel decides to live life differently by becoming the greatest swindler in the empire! Armed with a newfound goal and the determination to fulfill it, can Seizel succeed in going from noblewoman to con-woman?
___
"If you sign this paper, then Milady will become the Duchess of Leviaus for the next year. In exchange, you will receive a deposit of 100,000 rubles and if you fulfil the terms of the contract successfully, you will receive 1 million rubles."

A contract marriage to put an end to the rumour about Duke Leviaus, who has a status comparable to that of the imperial family! The rumour is that the woman who marries Duke Leviaus first will suddenly die from a curse within a year.

"If we could catch the person who spread such a wicked rumour, we would annihilate him, even if we have to mobilize all of the estate’s troops. So, don't mind the rumour, Milady."

"I'm really fine."

*Because… that rumour, was spread by me.*

Seizel, in her second life, dreams of becoming the best con artist who eats away at the empire. She was going to freely live her life by finding her fellow cellmates from her past life and scamming them… This guy looks like a huge pushover, but something's fishy. He's polite, but she thinks he looks a bit sly…?

Can she fulfil this contract safely?
description.id: Setelah ayah Seisel meninggal, semua orang malah mengkhianati dan menipunya hingga dia berakhir dihukum mati di penjara. Namun, Seisel malah kembali terbangun di hari kematian ayahnya, dan sadar kalau dia sudah hidup kembali setelah dihukum. Seisel pun bertekad hidup dengan bebas dan menjadi penipu untuk membalas dendam kehidupan sebelumnya. Seisel melakukan aksinya dan menikah kontrak dengan Putra Duke Rubius. Putra Duke Rubius adalah orang yang polos dan sopan, tapi dia juga terlihat mencurigakan! Lalu, bagaimana nasib Seisel selanjutnya?
description.ko:
"서류에 서명하시면 레이디께서는 앞으로 1년간 르비어스 공작부인이 되십니다."
“계약에 대한 대가로 선금 십만 루블, 완수되는 날 백만 루블을 받으시게 됩니다”

황가에 버금가는 위상을 가진 르비어스 공작의 떠도는 소문을 잠재우기 위해 시작된 계약 결혼!
그 소문은 [르비어스 공작과 처음 혼인하는 여자는 저주로 인하여 1년 안에 급사한다]는 것.

"그런 사특한 소문을 낸 자는 공작가의 힘을 총동원해서라도 찾아내 엄벌을 내릴 겁니다. 소문은 신경 쓰지 마십시오. 레이디."
“저는 정말 괜찮답니다.”

왜냐하면...
그 소문, 내가 낸 거거든.

제국을 등쳐먹는 최고의 사기꾼을 꿈꾸는 인생 2회차 세이젤.
지난 생의 감방 동기들을 줍줍해서 제대로 사기 치며 대놓고 막살려고 했는데…
이 남자, 엄청난 호구 같은데 어딘가 수상하다.
정중하긴 한데 어딘가 음흉해 보이는 것 같은데...?

과연 이 계약은 무사히 완수될 수 있을까?
description.pl: „Jeśli moja pani podpisze kontrakt, to zostanie pani “księżną Rubius” na rok czasu. W zapłatę za podpisanie kontraktu dostanie pani z góry 100 000 rubli, a kiedy kontrakt się skończy, dostanie pani milion rubli." Małżeństwo kontraktowe, aby położyć kres plotce o księciu Leviausie, mającym status porównywalny do rodziny cesarskiej! Plotka głosi, że kobieta, która jako pierwsza poślubi księcia Leviausa, w ciągu roku nagle umrze z powodu klątwy. „Z tego powodu będziemy szukać osoby, która je rozpowszechnia i ją surowo ukaramy. Dlatego też nie musi pani martwić się o nią…" "Naprawdę wszystko w porządku." Ponieważ… to ja stoję za tą plotką. Seizel w swoim drugim życiu marzy o zostaniu najlepszym oszustem, który pożera imperium. Zamierzała swobodnie żyć, odnajdując współwięźniów z poprzedniego życia i oszukując ich… Ten facet wygląda na wielkie popychadło, ale coś tutaj nie gra. Jest uprzejmy, ale ona uważa, że wygląda trochę przebiegle…? Czy uda jej się bezpiecznie wypełnić ten kontrakt?
description.ru:
Я! Хочу! Вернуться!

Под руководством своего упрямого отца Сизель жила как «самая совершенная леди в мире», пока ее не постигла неожиданная смерть в качестве убийцы.

В тот самый день, когда ее жалкое десятилетнее заключение должно было закончиться обезглавливанием, началась ее вторая жизнь.

Мне просто на это наплевать!

Я пересплю с ними, прежде чем они переспят со мной!

Я прожую их и выплюну прежде, чем они успеют слопать меня!

Больше никакой Мисс Милой девушки. Теперь же она решила жить так, как ей хочется!

Пока она была там, она планировала стать величайшей аферисткой, которая обманывает саму империю, и подобрала нескольких бывших сокамерников, чтобы начать второй акт своей жизни…

Почему мне кажется, что наступит конец света, когда я только что приняла решение!

– ....Открой глаза, ты отличный парень. Мне нужно, чтобы мои деньги стоили того.

Для мира, который легче эксплуатировать!

В качестве последнего акта милосердия она приняла и подлатала «последнего Хранителя империи» герцога Левиуса, спасая его от смерти. Теперь все, что он должен сделать, это принести славу империи…

Вау. Что же это за сосунок такой?

– О том, кто меня спас, я ничего не помню.

Человек, который спас его, – это я, но я собираюсь быть грязным незнакомцем, черт возьми, нет.

Таким образом, непреднамеренно завоёвывая титул герцогини, Сизель начинает с того, что получает ценные деньги.

– Пока ты вовремя платишь обещанные гонорары, я целый год буду вести себя как идеальная герцогиня.

– В этом нет необходимости. Всё в этом доме принадлежит Вашей Светлости.

Но этот человек был простофилей другого уровня, которого раньше никто не видел и не слышал. Вежливый, напористый, прилипчивый.

– Ч-что вы здесь делаете, Ваша Светлость?

– Это наша первая ночь вместе, Миледи.

...и развратный.

But his newest mission is his most absurd yet: make the Sect’s laziest, most notorious delinquent -- Wu Ma -- the next Cheonma. To pull it off, Iseo ditches his post and applies to be Wu Ma’s official aide. In a world of betrayal, martial arts, and political games, can even a talent like Iseo turn a hopeless young master into an heir?

description.en: The Demonic Cult Leader, Seok Woncho, was a monster who even surpassed the Blood Cult Leader. Do you know who killed him? “Ha Mu-baek.” “But why are you bringing that up…?” “Because he’s coming to our Mengryong Academy as an instructor.” …Damn it. We’re screwed! Ha Mu-baek, the greatest martial artist who crushed both the Demonic Cult and the Blood Cult, is now assigned as an instructor at a martial arts training academy due to a political power struggle. Determined to live quietly while keeping his identity hidden, he soon finds himself solving the problems of cadets with heart-wrenching backstories, disciplining the trashy human scum at the academy, and inexplicably becoming busier by the day… Welcome! It’s your first time meeting a genius lunatic instructor, isn’t it?!

description.de: Ich wollte nur wieder mit dir leben. Scarlet Dumfeld – Ehefrau des Helden Kapitän Victor – verliert nach einem Verhör eine ganze Woche ihrer Erinnerung. Zurück bleibt ein Skandal. Und ein Satz:„Du hast mich betrogen.“ Ohne Antworten entscheidet sie sich für die Scheidung – und beginnt neu. Doch Victor gibt sie nicht auf. „Ich werde dich zurückgewinnen.“ Eine Geschichte über verlorene Zeit, gebrochenes Vertrauen – und eine Liebe, die sich selbst retten muss.
description.en:
After losing critical memories, and discovering her husband’s betrayal through newspaper headlines, a woman divorces him to start anew as a clockmaker. But when the estranged man returns, insisting "If you hate me coming, then come back instead," their fragile dance begins: Can love rewrite the past when trust is broken?
___
When a shady police inquiry causes Scarlet Crimson to have a mysterious memory lapse and unknowingly betray her cold and distant husband, Victor Dumfeldt, their fragile marriage shatters in divorce. To start anew, she returns to her family’s watchmaking trade to rebuild her life and her parents' legacy. But when Victor reenters her life, Scarlet starts to wonder if what was broken can be repaired. Between memories lost and words unspoken, can they learn from what they didn’t know the first time?

내가 바라는 건 그저, 당신과 다시 사는 거야.
위대한 시계 장인들의 딸이며

그녀는 경찰청에서 취조를 받던 중,

"나가실 때쯤에는,
여기서 있었던 일을 기억하지 못하실 겁니다.”

사라진 일주일 간의 기억.
그리고 신문에 대서특필된
빅토르가 숨겨온 비밀.

아무것도 떠오르지 않아 해명조차 할 수 없었던 스칼렛은

description.ru:
Все, чего я хочу, — это снова жить с тобой.

Скарлетт Дамфельд, дочь великих часовщиков и жена героя, капитана Виктора.
Во время допроса в полицейском участке она теряет память из-за рук тех, кто выступает против возвращения Виктора в королевскую семью.

— "К тому времени, как вы уйдете, вы не вспомните, что здесь произошло."

Воспоминания о прошедшей неделе и тайна, которую скрывал Виктор, была раскрыта в газете.

— "Ты предал меня."

Скарлетт, которая даже сама не могла объяснить, потому что ей ничего не приходило в голову, в конце концов решила развестись с Виктором.
После этого он начинает кружить вокруг Скарлетт с незнакомым выражением лица, когда она начинает новую жизнь в качестве часовщика...

— "Почему ты все время сюда приходишь?"
— "Если ты не хочешь, чтобы я приходил, просто возвращайся. Я намерен вернуть тебя."

Печальная история взаимоспасения влюбленных незнакомцев.

description.en: “You have to become a villain to live? … But how do you do that?” One day, Da-jeong Kim, an ordinary Korean office worker who suddenly possesses the world of a novel. In fact, it is Christine Rosalind, the villain character who dies at the beginning of the novel in the series that she possessed. Perhaps because of Da-jeong’s possession, the original death is avoided, but that is only temporary. In a few moments, you die, and when you die, you return to the starting point of your life. How can I live without dying? The sky throws a clear answer to Da-jeong, who is in trouble. let her be a villain When she becomes a villain she can live without dying. … By the way, can she become a villain that only eats her heart? “A world collapsing, twisting characters. If you want to live, you have to remember who you are.” She said she could only live if she was a villain, did she mean that she could only live? After many twists and turns, she heard the voice of a villain, but Da-jeong’s life is hard and painful. It turns out that Christine was born into a civilization of ‘dead or bad’. Unexpected characters appear in front of Da-jeong, who is in such trouble. Raymon Myers, who is the man of the original story and is a perfect match for Christine, Diane Schneider, who was not found in the original, but has a reputation as a vicious witch in the world, and Cordelian Parker, who was possessed by the original author, the female lead of the original and the creator of this world. The three of them approach Da-jeong with different goals…

Everyone has their own little secrets.
My secret is about a special someone,
who isn't like anyone else.

Princess Canola, was forced to marry in an arranged marriage far away from the kingdom due to the fight for the throne. She fell in love with the first person she saw at first sight! However, the people of Tripol Kingdom treat her as a stranger and ignore her, and inform her that she cannot marry until she passes her three tests. Even her affection alone is enough to make her cold to her... She is here she can't back down. She has already named her grandson and granddaughter. I'll get through that test quickly!

---
Princess Canola arrives in wintery Tripol expecting a warm welcome from her future husband, Edel, and his kingdom. It's love at first sight the moment she lays eyes on him. But her picture-perfect fantasy comes crashing down when the people of Tripol reject an outlander for their prince. Now, Canola has to jump through hoops just to remain in Edel's orbit. Most would crumble under the pressure, but Canola isn't about to miss her chance to land herself a dreamy husband. She just has to find a way to melt prince charming's heart, and all the icy hearts in Tripol.

A quarta princesa de Charlemann, Canola F. Incana Charlemann, que foi expulsa de Charlemann por causa da luta de seu irmão pelo trono, foi informada que deveria se casar com o filho único do monarca de Tripol, cujo ela não conhece o rosto nem o nome.
A caminho de Tripol, através das irregulares montanhas nevadas, para um casamento, ela encontrou Ethel, o herdeiro de Tripol, seu prometido, seu futuro marido...
"Princesa, cumprimente-o depressa..."
Canola não respondeu o lembrete, apenas o encarou. Canola, que estava piscando os olhos e fazendo uma expressão estúpida, cobriu a boca com a mão e se virou.
"Acho que estou apaixonada."
Um homem tão puro e lindo! Ela não pode evitar se apaixonar por ele!
"Um homem que não pode nem proteger sua companheira não pode se tornar um guerreiro Tripol. Nós... Nós ainda temos um longo caminho até nos tornarmos um casal oficialmente, mas é meu trabalho protegê-la."
Quando Ethel terminou de falar, ele avançou com a fera na qual estava montado, cavalgando para longe. Canola, que estava encarando suas costas, lentamente retornou para a carruagem. Seu rosto estava levemente corado.

爭奪王位失利，只能被迫接受政策聯姻遠嫁他方的卡諾拉。卻對自己的未婚夫一見鐘情！ 但即將嫁去的特里波人卻將她視為外國人，不僅蔑視她，還提出必須通過三項考驗才能結婚。甚至連未婚夫對她的態度也極盡冷漠… 但本公主怎麼可能就此打退堂鼓呢？我可是連孫子、孫女名字都取好了呢！ 不過是個考驗而已，就快點過關斬將搞定它吧！

Arshe, who has always wished to live a stable life, is told by her brother that there was a marriage proposal from a neighboring country. When she’s forced to be sent there, she gets frustrated, worrying that she might get killed in a foreign land. After poisoning her brother to death, Arshe is locked up inside the palace. Then one day, a prince comes from the Empire to visit her. 

---
During a chance meeting, Princess Asché shares an unforgettable kiss with Ethan, the second prince of a nearby empire. Years later, Asché’s brother arranges a marriage that will force her to become the Emperor’s ninth wife. Rather than suffer in a loveless union, Asché poisons her brother, and is imprisoned in the palace for her crime. But as revolution stirs, Ethan, now an anti-imperial rebel, suddenly reappears in her bedroom, and a steamy romance fraught with political implications begins.
description.id:
Ashé, yang mengharapkan kehidupan yang stabil terpaksa ke negara lain setelah kakaknya mendapat tawaran pernikahan. Karena takut mati dengan cara yang mengerikan jika dia melakukan pernikahan yang tidak diinginkan, dia akhirnya meracuni saudaranya sendiri. Suatu hari, setelah dipenjara di istana karena kejahatan itu, pangeran kekaisaran datang untuk menemukannya.

---
Sebagai putri kerajaan yang dilahirkan oleh dayang istana, Ashe begitu mendambakan kebebasan. Namun sayangnya, William, kakak sekaligus pangeran pertama yang haus akan takhta justru menjodohkannya dengan kaisar yang terkenal ringan tangan. Ashe yang menolak perjodohan tersebut pun meracuni William hingga tewas. Tetapi, akankah kematian William menjadi titik terang bagi Ashe? Atau hidupnya justru menjadi semakin rumit setelah Ashe menjalin hubungan dengan pira yang dia pilih, yaitu Idan anak sang Kaisar?
description.ja: アメタン王国の王女アーシャは第一王子のウィリアムに王位を継承させ、王国を出て平穏な生活を送ることを望んでいた。 しかし、兄ウィリアムから皇帝の妃になることを強要されそうにー。 アーシェは兄を毒殺するも、その罪で監禁され、5年後に死刑となることを宣告される。 そんな中、前に帝国のパーティで偶然に出会い、忘れられない時を過ごした皇子イダンが訪れてきて…。

With a sense of pride, I took the first step forward, but somehow things didn't go as expected and the situation became increasingly complicated... description.en:
<What happened in St. John’s College>

She transmigrated into a novel that is only 1% romance. It was a 19+, mature, smut novel. However, she never cared that the novel she transmigrated into was considered trash by everyone else.

"Thank you very much for reincarnating me as an extra who doesn't even appear in the original story!'

Though, she had no plans of interacting with any of the main characters! After graduating, she plans to become a daring author and live a carefree life, free of stress!

Fate, on the other hand, seems to have an entirely different plan...

"It's here, the place where tragedy will befall in the near future..."

Due to some mix up, Genevieve, who planned to enrol in Four Gates Academy, ended up enrolling in Saint John's College.

Whether this is fortunate or not, it was only after she entered Saint John's College did she realise that she had transmigrated before the main characters even appeared!

Unfortunately,  just as she peacefully started her third year, fate just had to continue twisting things out of her favour.

"You're the senior Genevieve Darling, right?"

The novel's second male lead, who mind you, will commit a great massacre in the future, is actively seeking her out?!!!

But...

"...I apologise for bothering you. I'll be quiet so I do not disturb you while you do your assignments."

"You're the one who was being harassed, so why are you apologising?!"

The corrupted second male lead is too gentle right now, even if he had a dark past, this is...

From that moment on, Genevieve had made up her mind. Even if she does not change what happens in the original novel, she believes that when Edward remembers this period of his life later on, she will be able to give him at least one good memory!

"It's okay, Edward. You can stay right here."

Will Genevieve fulfil her goal of giving the second male lead pleasant memories?
description.ko:
<세인트 존 칼리지에서 일어난 일>
로맨스가 단 1퍼센트 첨가된, 19금 피폐 소설에 빙의했다.
하지만, 그녀는 빙의한 소설이 피폐물인들 상관없었다.

‘원작에서 등장도 안 하는 모브 엑스트라에 빙의시켜 주셔서 감사합니다!’

등장인물과 접점이라곤 조금도 없을 예정이니까!
이후 졸업장을 따고, 달링 후작이 되어 떵떵거리며 살 예정이니까!

하지만,
이게 무슨 운명의 장난인지…….

‘여기구나. 훗날 그 참극이 벌어지는 곳이…….’

<포가츠 아카데미>에 입학할 예정이었던 제네비브는
모종의 사건으로 인해 <세인트 존 칼리지>에 입학하게 된다.

그나마 불행인지 다행인지.
그녀는 <세인트 존 칼리지>에 입학하고서야 깨달았다.
자신이 빙의한 시점이 남주와 여주가 등장하기 전이라는 걸.

하지만, 그녀가 편안한 마음으로 3학년을 맞았을 때.
운명은 그녀의 삶을 뒤바꿀 또 하나의 파란을 불러온다.

“제네비브 달링 선배, 맞으시죠.”

장차 대량 학살을 저지를 예정인
소설 속 서브 남주가 그녀를 찾아왔으니까!

그런데…….

“……신경 쓰게 해서 죄송합니다. 과제에 방해가 되지 않도록 조용히 있을게요.”
‘괴롭힘당한 건 넌데, 왜 네가 사과를 해?!’

……흑막 서브 남주가 순해도 너무 순하다.
아무리 그의 어두운 과거 시점이라지만, 이건 너무…….

그때부터 제네비브는 결심했다.

제힘으로 원작을 모두 바꾸진 못하더라도
에드워드가 나중에 이 시절을 떠올렸을 때
하나라도 좋았던 추억을 만들어 주기로!

“괜찮아, 에드워드. 여기 있어도 돼.”

장차 흑막이 될 서브남주에게 좋은 추억을 선물하기!
제네비브의 목표는 이루어질 수 있을까?

description.en: Woori Nam has always been the golden boy—wealthy, carefree, and untouchably lucky. But on the leap day of 2028, his 7th real birthday, everything changes. A seemingly harmless reunion with an old classmate, Subin Shin, ends in a brutal murder. And then, inexplicably, Woori wakes up back in high school, right beside Subin who has no idea that he just killed his deskmate. Trapped in a deadly time loop where almost every timeline ends with his death at Subin’s hands, Woori becomes desperate to escape his fate. After multiple resets, Woori finally comes to the conclusion that the only path to survival may be ensuring Subin’s happiness. With just one life left, Woori sets out to give Subin the happiest life possible.

description.en:
The scripture that brought a bloodstorm to Jianghu was the "Wisdom of the Secret Master," a legendary book that is said to hold the power to seize all the world's authority and wealth. Because of it, Woonseon lost all his loved ones overnight. 
Now, he casts aside his bright and pure past and embarks on a desperate journey for revenge. The flower will wither in ten days. Nothing in this world will be eternal, whether it's wealth, power, or love.

The Holy Empire of Serife’s saintess, Lily Stella. 

She was a holy existence that nobody dared to disrespect. But one day, she stopped hearing God’s voice, and the Holy Empire of Serife fell to ruin. Lily Stella, who was thrown into a well by the hands of the enemy, cursed the God of Serife whom she served all her life with all her might. 

“Serife. If you’re still listening to my voice, give me another opportunity. But if I die like this and return to your arms, I…” 

“I will tear you to pieces and eat you alive.” 

When she opened her eyes, wondering what happened, she had become Lily Stella of 17 years ago. She had returned as a 6 year old child... 

She threw away her past life’s innocent self as the saintess.
Deciding to become wicked, and to only live for herself.

description.en:
Bizzare phenomena all over the continent struck fear in the mighty Guelle empire. A sacrifice must be made to appease the heavens. How convenient is it that the royal throne just put out an announcement that they're looking for a tribute bride of noble birth with a hefty sum of money as a reward? Enter Valia Dean, who just overcame her second near-death experience as a destitute orphan. In order to save Karl, the senile mercenary who raised her in her late parents' absence, Valia volunteers to marry Marquess Shuden Gartt, whose reputation for massacre pales in frightfulness to the coldness of his gaze. Valia, hardened by misfortune, orphancy, starvation, and betrayal, accepts what seems to be certain death. Even in marriage, she will not love. It won't matter how handsome, rich, gentle, chivalrous, and caring he is, or how lovingly he behaves as her husband, right?

_

Valia was born into a fallen noble family as the daughter of a knight and lived a sad life. Then, the opportunity of a second life comes to her.

‘Should I live like that again?’

No, she won’t!

Valia decides to become a temple princess in order to live a happier life without having to worry about money. But then, as a princess, she becomes the wife of Shuden, the most handsome man and highest-ranking noble in the Empire…!

But in the future, Shuden falls in love with a new woman from another world. Valia knows this, but she can’t get away from Shuden, who is in love with her!

Valia, Shuden’s princess–what is her fate?

“You are the only one in my life that I will love. If I break my oath…I will pay for it with my life.”

"Стоит ли мне оставить все, как было?"
Конечно нет!
Валия решает стать храмовой принцессой, чтобы жить счастливо и не беспокоиться о деньгах. И будучи принцессой она выходит замуж за Шудена — самого привлекательного и знаменитого дворянина во всей Империи!..

Tras una espantosa ceremonia matrimonial, Kyle exige que se cumpla cierta promesa, lo que confunde a Elena.
description.fa: همون‌طور که قول دادی من رو بکش. وقتی یک روز خواهر دوقلوش لیلا، قدیسه، ناگهان ناپدید می‌شه، النا عادی می‌بینه که باید به جای اون با ولیعهد کایل، مردی بدنام به خاطر بی‌رحمی‌اش ازدواج کنه. پس از یک مراسم ازدواج وحشتناک، کایل خواستار انجام یک وعده خاص می‌شه که باعث سردرگمی النا شده.
description.fr: Elena et Leïla sont deux sœurs jumelles que tout oppose. Leïla, la Sainte gardienne de l'empire, est dotée de pouvoirs magiques exceptionnels et est promise à Kyle, descendant du dragon et prince héritier de la couronne de Lanvyer, à qui elle a juré de mettre fin au sort funèbre grâce à sa magie. Mais la veille de leur mariage, cette dernière disparaît mystérieusement. C'est donc sa sœur Elena, qui ne possède aucun pouvoir et dont l'existence avait jusqu'à présent été cachée, qui prend sa place. Désormais princesse héritière, Elena doit se fondre dans son nouvel environnement. Réussira-t-elle à honorer la promesse faite par sa sœur sans se faire repérer, ou échouera-t-elle malgré ses efforts?
description.id:
"Bunuh aku, seperti yang telah kau janjikan."

Setelah upacara pernikahan yang mengerikan, Kyle menuntut sebuah janji yang harus dipenuhi, yang membuat Elena bingung.

Nach einem tödlichen Unfall wird Rosa in die Welt eines Romans, den sie gelesen hatte, wiedergeboren. Als Rosa Veronica muss sie dort bereits als Mädchen hart arbeiten, um über die Runden zu kommen. Eines Tages kommt ein Bediensteter von Herzog Estella, ihrem leiblichen Vater, und bringt sie zu ihm, wo sie fortan als Rozenta Estella, dem einzigen Sohn und Erben von Herzog Estella leben soll. Sie entschließt sicht dazu, sich auf dieses neue Leben einzulassen und ist überrascht, dass sich die Charaktere anders als im Roman entwickeln, obwohl die grundsätzliche Geschichte gleich bleibt. Obwohl Rozenta Estella nur eine Nebenrolle im Originalroman innehatte, lernt Rosa, ihr Leben selbst in die Hand zu nehmen. description.en:
Rosa remembers her past life.
She remembers reading about the Helios Empire in a novel before dying suddenly in an accident.

When she is reborn into that exact world as Rosa Veronica, she lives day to day and works hard to make ends meet until one day when someone from the Duke of Estella’s estate comes to fetch her.
When she arrives and meets her biological father, her life is turned upside down once again as she’s forced to live the life of Rozenta Estella, the sole heir to the Estella estate and the only son of the Duke of Estella. Through the power of magical artifacts, she's able to live the life of Rozenta, a supporting male character from a novel she once read in a previous life.

She decides to embrace this new life as the familiar narrative unfolds before her. Despite knowing the overall story and its characters, she's surprised that the male and female leads have not become the characters she's read about. Although Rozenta Estella was just a minor character in the original novel, Rosa learns to navigate the intricacies of his life and family while fostering a budding friendship with Theodore and Vivian.

Her happiness doesn't last very long as all three grow up and enter the roles they've been born into.

Will Sena's feelings ever reach Daese?

The sealed myths and legends have returned to reality. A world where all gods and dragons are liberated, and demons and ghosts have come back. The awakening of humans. The emergence of heroes. A new era of mythology has opened. This story is a narrative about the war and love of the heroes who live in the new era of mythology, or perhaps a new myth.

If love is the ultimate prize, then the perils of courtship are the necessary trials and tribulations one must endure in its pursuit. 

It is a blessing for the society debutantes of London, then, that Cupid’s arrow should be guided by the dainty hand of Miss Laura Pendleton, granddaughter of Countess Pendleton and the city’s finest matchmaker. 

When Laura’s self-ascribed duties call her to befriend the stoic and saturnine Mr. Ian Dalton of Whitefield, however, she soon finds that when it comes to the grand contest of love, it may well be every woman for herself…

Elle est momentanément déboussolée, mais Cheon Nyeon-bi, désormais satisfaite de sa vie au palais, décide de mener une existence paisible en tant que concubine. Cependant, elle est rapidement confrontée à une nouvelle réalité lorsqu'elle est appelée dans la chambre de l'empereur pour remplir ses devoirs.
